description: The committed ogg/external-opusenc-16-harmonic.opus (opusenc, opus-tools 0.2, libopus 1.4, at 16 kbit/s, 4 s of stereo harmonics of a pitch that changes every 0.5 s at 48,000 Hz), decoded with opusdec.

encoder.name: opusenc
encoder.command: opusenc --bitrate 16 in.wav external-opusenc-16-harmonic.opus; opusdec --rate 48000 external-opusenc-16-harmonic.opus out.wav

tools: LAME 3.100, vorbis-tools 1.4.2 (oggenc, oggdec), FFmpeg 6.1.1-3ubuntu5 (aac), opus-tools 0.2 with libopus 1.4 (opusenc, opusdec), flac 1.4.3 (Ubuntu 24.04)
